## Tooling

No change to how tmux-legion behaves; this release is maintenance.

- **CI runs on a pinned image.** The workflow now runs on `ubuntu-24.04` instead of `ubuntu-latest`, so GitHub's switch of `ubuntu-latest` to Ubuntu 26 on 2026-10-19 can't change the build underneath the project. The actions also moved off the deprecated Node 20 runtime.
- **Copilot detection has its own module.** Copilot's screen parsing moved into `src/detect/copilot.rs`, matching Codex, and one dispatch now lists the agents that get screen detection. Copilot's detection rules are unchanged.

## Install

### Nix flake

```nix
# Pin to a release tag (recommended); drop the ref to track the default branch.
inputs.tmux-legion.url = "github:hawkish/tmux-legion/v0.7.2";
```

### Manual and TPM-style

```bash
git clone https://github.com/hawkish/tmux-legion ~/.tmux/plugins/tmux-legion
cd ~/.tmux/plugins/tmux-legion && cargo build --release
echo 'run-shell ~/.tmux/plugins/tmux-legion/tmux-legion.tmux' >> ~/.tmux.conf
```

Upgrading needs a tmux config reload, not just a rebuild — see [After upgrading](https://github.com/hawkish/tmux-legion#after-upgrading). The [README](https://github.com/hawkish/tmux-legion#install) covers Claude Code hooks, the agent skill, and the pi extension.
